scope: New signed/parity refinement of the already proved primitive local density, with exact original source normalization; no new count-supplier closure or global norm bound.

audit_groups.details: The exact primitive count and dyadic lifting already appear in recovered70, md-frame-count and md-lifting, with an explicit application to the source density. The corrected note credits that result. The new shared fragment contains the signed/parity refinement, not a duplicate proof or new whole-node closure.

LocE is a reduced quadratic algebra over a characteristic-zero local field with its integral closure and reduced residue algebra; it is unramified quadratic or split. HermSp12-19 supplies finite freeness and nondegeneracy. Self-duality gives a free maximal-order lattice and nondegenerate reduced form. The nonmaximal split order used for other kernels does not replace this order.

Source density is the range of primitive residue frames satisfying Gram congruences, normalized by q^(2Nm-m^2). Saturation is equivalent to independent residue classes; basis completion lifts every such residue tuple. No Hensel lifting of an exact Gram equation is required. The given split modified tuple is retained.

In the split case fixing X gives q^((N-m)(m-c)) times the independent restriction on ker A for Y. In the inert case trace and norm surjectivity diagonalize the Hermitian form without dividing by two. Additive-character orthogonality gives the stated V_D,Z_D. Quotienting an isotropic i-plane gives q^(2i) lifts of each nonzero null vector; the product and total q exponent are correct.

Odd-start adjacent products are at least one and even-start products at most one; removing the first factor bounds the opposite endpoint. Unmatched factors have the same sign as the first. The empty product is one. Hence the error has sign determined by d parity and absolute size at most q^(-d) in the inert case.

Params has even k,m and m+3<=k, hence k-m>=4. With m=2r+2 and N=k+m-1, d=k-c. A positive inert error requires c odd and therefore c<=m-1, giving exponent k-m+1. The bound supplies the exact DensAt consumer and the estimate part of FamilyVolumeFourth with constant one; scalar-pair equality is a separate assertion.

Absolute convergence follows from the uniform absolute deviations and s>1. Only the positive inert factors need enter the upper log bound. There are at most f places over each rational prime, and the integer-tail integral gives 2^(-s)(1+2/(s-1)). Determinant support is asserted only when one original global Gram matrix is supplied.

Independently reran the frozen checker: six pinned sources, 24 finite-field cases comprising 454 Gram matrices, 2464 signed endpoint cases, 7680 original even-rank cases, 20 norm counts, and four rejected controls. In particular dropping primitivity produces split density5/4 and invalidates the split<=1 conclusion. This is supporting exact finite evidence, not a full Lean build.

limitations: No construction of the original global period maps or archimedean operator estimates.
Scalar-pair density invariance is not proved by this package.
No full Lean compilation or whole-node change.
